rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Horus as documented Ra-Harahkhte, falcon-headed sun god and royal defender.
ANATOMY: ONE falcon head with two eyes hooked beak and feathered cheeks, human male body with exactly two arms two legs, fully opaque dark linen tunic and ankle-length wrap, Egyptian DOUBLE CROWN combining white tall crown and red lower crown, large ROUND gold sun disk on crown [horus-c06]. NO wings added to human body.
POWER: sun domain embodied through real low sun lighting crown and casting long sharp shadows, NO invented magic [horus-c06].
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low CLOSE angle, falcon head doublecrown/disk dominate, no giant size.
LIGHT: single dying warm sun through doorway, dust, deep black-gold shadows.
SURFACE: real falcon feathers, weathered metal, rough opaque woven cloth, stone.
SETTING: Egyptian royal throne and plain unlettered palace stone [horus-c22,c23].
MOOD: imposing protective royal authority, awe-inspiring and alert, never decorative neutral statue.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no hieroglyphs/pseudo-letters or text anywhere on crown/throne/walls/clothes, no logos/borders/watermarks, no extra anatomy, no film/game/anime designs, no nudity/gore, no aura/neon/ribbons.
MOMENT: Horus surges up from throne, one hand grips stone armrest with visible weight, other adjusts his doublecrown as he turns falcon face down toward viewer. Tight frontal three-quarter view.

source_claims.quote: In time, he became combined with the sun god Ra to form a new deity, Ra-Harahkhte, god of the sun who sailed across the sky during the day and was depicted as a falcon-headed man wearing the double crown of Upper and Lower Egypt with the sun disk on it.

statement.id: Horus kelak berpadu dengan Ra menjadi Ra-Harahkhte, dewa matahari berkepala elang.
statement.en: Horus later combined with Ra as Ra-Harahkhte, a falcon-headed sun god.

source_claims.quote: He was the protector of the royalty of Egypt, avenger of wrongs, defender of order, uniter of the two lands and, based on his battles with Set, a god of war regularly invoked by Egyptian rulers before battle and praised afterwards.

statement.id: Horus Muda adalah pelindung kerajaan Mesir, pembalas kezaliman, pembela ketertiban, pemersatu dua negeri, dan dewa perang yang diseru para penguasa Mesir sebelum pertempuran.
statement.en: Horus the Younger was protector of Egypt's royalty, avenger of wrongs, defender of order, uniter of the two lands, and a war god invoked by Egyptian rulers before battle.

source_claims.quote: Set is then banished to the desert lands beyond Egypt's borders while Horus assumes the throne of his father with his mother and aunt Nephthys as consorts.

statement.id: Dalam versi pertama, Set diusir ke gurun di luar perbatasan Mesir, sementara Horus naik takhta ayahnya dengan ibunya dan bibinya, Nephthys, sebagai permaisuri.
statement.en: In the first version Set is banished to the deserts beyond Egypt's borders while Horus takes his father's throne with his mother and aunt Nephthys as consorts.

source_claims.quote: Having conquered Set and restored order, Horus became known as Horu-Sema-Tawy, The Horus, Uniter of the Two Lands.

statement.id: Setelah menaklukkan Set dan memulihkan ketertiban, Horus dikenal sebagai Horu-Sema-Tawy, Horus Pemersatu Dua Negeri.
statement.en: Having conquered Set and restored order, Horus became known as Horu-Sema-Tawy, the Horus who unites the Two Lands.
